description: Raise an issue on this organization's own issues list, where it lands on the issues board and on the Issues section of that team's Delta Meeting. Use this when someone wants something on the agenda: a problem to work through, a decision to make, a topic to raise. Pass team_id to put it in front of a specific team's meeting -- get it from list_meetings, which returns each meeting's teamId; omit it and the issue is org-wide and unassigned, which is a real state, not a failure. This is the org's OWN issue list. To report a bug or request a feature FROM the OTP vendor, use submit_ticket instead -- the two look similar and go to completely different places.

category.description: Default 'other', which is what an agenda item usually is

description.description: Detail, if the person gave any. Do NOT invent one: leave it out and the issue records where it came from instead.

horizon.description: 'short' (default) is worked day to day; 'long' parks it for the quarterly.

owner_external_id.description: Seat that owns the issue, e.g. 'HUM_DAVIDSTEEL' or 'AGT_RADAR'

team_id.description: Team whose meeting should show this issue, from list_meetings' teamId. Omit or pass null for an org-wide issue on no team.

title.description: The issue as the person said it, e.g. 'Feedback for customers wanting to cancel'

name: add_issue
